dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: ...Your cold was caused by the physical and mental strain you've been under lately, I fear. Such things are more common with the changing of the seasons.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Just prescribe some more medicine for me, if you would. I'll have someone pick it up in a few days.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: As you say. However... while colds can be cured with medication, overexertion could cause it to recur.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Thank you for your advice, Dr. Baizhu, but I simply cannot ignore the affairs of state... Alleviating the symptoms through your prescriptions should suffice for now.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: *sigh* I will write up some more nourishing dietary prescriptions. Please, take things slow, and avoid weakening your body too much.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, our distinguished guest. Is there some urgent matter at hand?

choices.text: Well, you seem like you haven't had enough rest, for one...

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I slept too little last night, and after getting up, there was a chill draft... so I caught a cold.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I was planning to just deal with it using a bit of medicine, but a massive headache came with the package, so I had to invite Dr. Baizhu over.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Heh. My apologies, Dr. Baizhu, for having to have you come over every so often to adjust my prescriptions.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Not at all. Diagnosing, treating, and saving people are all well within my duties. But...

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Then you know that this too is where my duty lies, Dr. Baizhu.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: The Ministry of Civil Affairs is the crossroads where many matters meet, all of which must be seen to with care. To that end, no amount of effort is too great.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Hehe... If you think just me having a headache is bad, imagine the number of people who'd get one if I were to just drop my work all of a sudden.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: And if everyone at the Ministry became overtaxed... I imagine Liyue Harbor itself would catch a cold then.
